notes:
The page contains cancelled Kummer and H³ fragments, local-cohomology case tables, the Z–Q–Q/Z sequence and two further sequences with marginal identifications. The source’s comment reads “pas de miracle, car les deux sont nuls.” The last H³(Ubar,G_m)=0 identification carries a question mark. The connecting degree was inspected because the cohomological sequence suggests i+1, but the tiny ink stroke remains ambiguous and has not been replaced by that expectation. The heavily retraced first zero and the fragmented marks after the first long sequence remain doubtful.

177.N1: For the displayed Z–Q–Q/Z sequence, the usual maps are the inclusion j:Z→Q and quotient q:Q→Q/Z. The inclusion has zero kernel; q(a)=0 exactly for a∈Z, so ker(q)=im(j); every coset has a rational representative, so q is onto. This checks that algebraic sequence, and supplies no proof of the page’s cohomology calculations. Archive number 176; no date.
